{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the presence of 'loyal' in customer_segment
print("Unique customer_segments:", df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check if 'converted' is binary (0 or 1)
print("Value counts for 'converted':\n", df['converted'].value_counts())

# Check if 'status' affects conversion — i.e., is there any order with converted=0 but status='completed'? 
# But per documentation, 'converted' is the correct indicator. Still, check for consistency.
conversion_status_check = df[['converted', 'status']].value_counts().reset_index(name='count')
print("Conversion status consistency check (converted vs status):\n", conversion_status_check)

# Check for duplicates — but only if needed. The contract says no need to deduplicate, but verify.
df_duplicated = df[df.duplicated(subset=['order_id'], keep=False)]
print("Number of duplicate order_id entries:", len(df_duplicated))

# Also check for the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())
print("Number of refunded orders:", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
